mode_evidence: He describes the vision as 'a vivid picture affecting the focus and retina of the eye', with pupils expanding and contracting and sparkling specks in the milky field, and says the visions are 'in the soul of the seer', the crystal acting through the optic nerves. The second kind is an 'apperception rather than a perception'. So most is claimed as seen, with some imaginal impression.
onset_evidence: For one who sees nothing: regular short sittings of fifteen minutes, daily, at the same hour and place; nothing may happen for the first few sittings or many; the faculty 'in a few days, weeks, or months' may flower. Appended directions say those seemingly insensitive can develop it by frequent trials of fifteen to twenty minutes. If the quest is unsuccessful after a period of earnest trial it is warrant that the faculty is not among one's powers. Prerequisites: truthfulness, resignation, no selfish desire. Some are 'born rather than made'.

conditions.posture: sit comfortably with back to the light, sphere held in the palm on the lap, or on a stand against a black velvet screen
conditions.setting: moderately warm, shady room, not actually dark, light enough to just read average print; no direct rays on the crystal; others at arm's length and silent
conditions.duration_and_schedule: fifteen minutes at first, daily, same hour and place; fifteen to twenty minutes in the directions
conditions.prerequisites: love of truth, self-possession, freedom from selfish desire
conditions.other: keep the crystal in a black cover in the dark; low monotone questions only

stages.label: cloud over
stages.description: The crystal becomes dull, then suffused with milky clouds with specks of light like gold dust in sunlight; focus inconstant; the crystal may vanish in a haze and return.

stages.label: azure expanse
stages.description: Clouds and dancing starlights suddenly vanish; a bright azure expanse like a summer sky fills the field; a spasm-like sensation in the brain, tightening of the scalp, a caught breath.

stages.label: vision
stages.description: The first vision stands clear and life-like against the azure screen.

stages.label: sphere directions
stages.description: Sphere ceases to reflect and turns milky; a clouded colour follows (generally red, then green), turning to blackness that rolls away like a curtain to disclose pictures.

what_to_do_with_light: Persevere through the cloud stage; stay self-possessed at the azure moment so as not to be startled out of the state.
obstacles_and_fixes: Nothing happens for many sittings: keep regular, patient and self-controlled
Being startled into full waking consciousness at the moment of vision: self-possession and confidence
cautions: Ceremonial magic with the crystal is 'highly dangerous'
A selfish or self-seeking spirit will distort or shut the visions
Excess of joy or fear at the vision is fatal to its continuance
interpretation: The visions are in the soul of the seer; the crystal's odylic substance responds to the seer's nervo-vital emanations and acts on the brain centres through the optic nerves.
practice_summary: Sit with your back to a north or shaded light, with a good unblemished crystal or sphere on a stand against black velvet so no reflections or direct rays fall on it. The room should be shady but light enough to read by. Gaze steadily and silently for fifteen minutes, daily at the same hour and place. The first signs are that the crystal dulls, fills with milky clouds with sparkling specks like gold dust, and may vanish in haze while your eyes lose focus. This may be all that happens for a few sittings or many. Then the clouds and starlights vanish, a bright azure sky fills the field, you feel a stir in the head and the scalp tightens, and the vision appears on the blue. Stay calm at that moment so you are not startled out of it.
